'''Willy Haeberli''' (June 17, 1925 – October 4, 2021) was a Swiss-American physicist and professor emeritus of Physics at the [[University of Wisconsin, Madison]]. He was known for his works in [[nuclear physics]]. He was a winner of the [[Tom W. Bonner Prize in Nuclear Physics]] and of the [[Humboldt Prize]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Willy Haeberli remembered as physicist, teacher, and museum supporter |url=https://www.physics.wisc.edu/2021/10/15/willy-haeberli-remembered-as-physicist-teacher-and-museum-supporter/ |website=Department of Physics}}</ref>
